app.title: poligloti
app.subtitle: A patient AI language teacher that never judges you
select.heading: Hi, I'm your teacher
talk.empty: When you talk or write, your corrections and new vocabulary will show up here.
talk.switchConfirm: This will close the current session. Switch mode?
progress.title: My progress
progress.empty: No progress data yet. Take the initial assessment to gauge your level.
progress.eligible: Your scores say you're ready to level up!
setup.1.desc: Free chat about whatever you like: work, travel, daily life. The teacher corrects you gently as you talk.
setup.2.desc: Pick a situation. The teacher plays the character (waiter, colleague, taxi driver…) and the scene starts on its own.
setup.3.desc: Paste a text in the language you're studying. You'll work on it together: vocabulary, comprehension and your opinion.
setup.3.title: Text title (optional)
setup.3.placeholder: Paste the article or text here…
setup.5.desc: Practice real emails and workplace chat messages. The teacher reviews your drafts; a simulated colleague replies.
setup.5.subject: Subject (optional)
setup.7.desc: Learn expressions native speakers actually use, the ones you can't get by translating word for word. Pick a theme or let me surprise you.
expr.free.placeholder: Or type a theme (e.g. expressions for negotiating…)
setup.4.desc: Read a text out loud and I'll mark, word by word, what sounded clear and what's worth reviewing.
setup.4.pairs.desc: Word pairs that differ by a single sound. Listen, read them aloud and check whether the difference comes through.
pairs.empty: No pairs available for this language.
pairs.disclaimer: Listen-and-repeat exercise. Tap ♪ to hear each word, imitate them and compare. The automatic check is only a rough hint: speech recognizers struggle with isolated words, so trust your ear and the mouth tip.
pairs.same: They sounded similar to the recogniser. Listen to both ♪ and compare.
pairs.unclear: It didn't catch the words well (normal with isolated words). Listen ♪ and imitate.
setup.4.paste.placeholder: Paste the text you want to read (your script, a paragraph…)
setup.4.topic.placeholder: Topic (e.g. a presentation about your job, tech news…)
setup.4.generate.hint: The app will generate a text in the language you're studying, at your level.
read.instructions: Read the text out loud. Tap to record and tap again when you're done.
read.flagged.title: Words to review
read.disclaimer: Indicative only: based on what the speech recognizer understands, not a phonetic analysis.
call.permission.title: I need microphone access
call.permission.body: Your browser will ask for permission. If you deny it, use Write mode.
chat.placeholder: Write in the language you're studying…
chat.empty: Start writing in the language you're studying.
write.thread.empty: You haven't sent anything yet. Write your message and tap “Send to colleague”.
write.feedback.title: Teacher's feedback
write.feedback.empty: Write a draft and ask for feedback before sending it, or send it straight to the colleague.
error.generic: The turn failed, please try again
error.network: Can't reach the poligloti server. Check that the backend is running.
error.timeout: The server is taking too long to respond. Try again.
error.model: The teacher hit a problem. Try again.
health.degraded: The model server isn't responding. Voice and replies may fail.
health.offline: Can't reach the poligloti server. Check that the backend is running.
summary.title: Your session recap
summary.loading: The teacher is preparing your recap…
summary.analysisError: Your turns are saved, but the teacher could not analyse this session:
summary.empty: Short session: nothing to recap this time.
review.title: Vocabulary review
review.empty: All caught up! No words due right now. Come back tomorrow or after your next session.
setup.3.story.desc: A chaptered story written at your level that also reinforces your pending vocabulary. Continue yours or start a new one.
setup.3.story.topic: Topic (optional: a mystery in Berlin, a train trip…)
setup.3.story.hint: The teacher writes the chapter and you work through it together as a reading.
ocr.desc: Take a photo or upload a screenshot of any text (an article, an email, whatever you like): I'll transcribe it and we'll work on it together.
ocr.desc4: Take a photo or upload a screenshot of a text: I'll transcribe it and you read it aloud with word-by-word feedback.
ocr.review: Review the extracted text (fix anything off) and start.
ocr.hint: Takes 15-30 seconds. You'll be able to review the text before starting.
books.title: My Books
books.desc: Your books with continuity: the teacher remembers the plot and your vocabulary for each one.
books.empty: No books yet. Create your first one with its title.
books.page.label: Page number you're about to read
books.photo.desc: Take a photo of today's page (or upload a screenshot if you read online).
books.start: Start: first you read it aloud
home.reason.assessment: You haven't done it yet: it sets your level and plan.
home.reason.review: Time to catch up on your week.
home.reason.free: Let's chat for a bit in your language.
lesson.intro: A micro-lesson on one syllabus topic: a little theory and a lot of practice.
lesson.done: You've completed all the available syllabus. 🎉
progress.trend.empty: No curve to draw yet: it shows up from the second session with saved scores.
progress.assessment.pending: You haven't done the initial assessment yet
progress.assessment.why: Your level was set by hand. The assessment calibrates your real level and builds your plan and weekly focus.
progress.assessment.redo.hint: Recalibrates your level and rebuilds the plan. Use it when you feel you've moved on.
books.endPageAsk: Which page did you stop at?
notice.noStt: Voice input is off: set STT_MODEL to talk instead of typing.
notice.noVoice: No voice available for {language} on this device: showing text only.
notice.noVision: Set AI_VISION_MODEL to read pages from a photo.
pron.timestamps: Your speech-to-text server does not return word timestamps, so pronunciation practice is off.
books.paste.desc: Paste the text of the page you're about to read.
setupRequired.title: poligloti needs a chat model
setupRequired.intro: poligloti works with any OpenAI-compatible chat model, running locally (like Ollama) or hosted. Configure it in the backend's .env file.
setupRequired.var.apiKey: optional, only if the server needs a key
setupRequired.restart: Then restart the backend and check again.
setupRequired.readme: More options (speech-to-text, voices, vision) are in the README, section “Configuration”.
newLearner.intro: Welcome! Tell me who you are and which language you want to learn.
newLearner.name: Your name
newLearner.goals.placeholder: e.g. meetings at work, a trip next summer, talking with my partner's family…
newLearner.goals.hint: The teacher reads this to choose topics and situations for you.
